name: Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna
summary: Gokarna Mahabaleshwar — coastal Jyotirlinga-adjacent fame with Atmalinga tradition.
mythology: Mahabaleshwar Temple, Gokarna at Gokarna, Uttara Kannada, Karnataka is dedicated to Lord Shiva (Mahabaleshwar), known especially for Atmalinga lore · beach-temple pilgrim/tourist search. Pilgrimage tradition places the shrine within India’s tirtha network — a seat where vows, gratitude, and family kuladevi / ishta devotion gather. Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching elaborate how Lord Shiva (Mahabaleshwar) blesses those who arrive with sincere intent; festival days intensify these beliefs through special alankara and community worship where practised.
